title: Rav Chana bar Ada
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: In Berakhot 62b he reports Rav Sama, son of Rav Mari. Yevamot 78b mentions him saying that David decreed against the Netinim. Yuchasin says he was Rav Yehudah’s student, but Hyman writes that he found no source for this. Chullin 133a mentions his son Mar Yochana in Rava’s time.

notes.text: The failure to locate support for the Yuchasin student claim is Hyman’s statement, not a new claim that all sources have been searched.
